description: DUT accepts NOP and EOL options in a SYN and completes the handshake (RFC 1122 §4.2.2.5 p85)
approach:
[Objective]
NOP (kind=1, no length) and EOL (kind=0, ends option list) are universal padding/terminator markers. DUT must walk past them without confusion.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. DUT in LISTEN.
2. Tester → DUT: SYN with options blob containing NOP+EOL (and MSS).
3. Observation: DUT → Tester: SYN,ACK + DUT reaches ESTABLISHED.

[Pass condition]
DUT completes handshake.

[Fail condition]
• Fail_not_established — DUT did not reach ESTABLISHED
• Fail_timeout — no DUT SYN,ACK

verdicts.Fail_timeout: No DUT SYN,ACK within listen window
